key_features_to_build.name: SaaS Shell Navigation
key_features_to_build.description: Left sidebar with brand logo mark ('AegisNet' SVG shield node logo), live system status indicator (ONLINE - GATEWAY #1 ACTIVE), navigation tabs (Dashboard, Floor Map & Doors, NVR Live Feeds, Employee Enrollment, Access Devices, Real-time Events Log), top header with search, active building selector (e.g., HQ North Tower - Floor 4), active alerts pill, and security officer profile.

key_features_to_build.name: SOC Live Dashboard
key_features_to_build.description: High-density grid layout with 4 summary stat widgets (People Inside: 142/200, Doors Online: 18/20, Active NVR Cameras: 12/12, Critical Security Alerts: 02), real-time live events feed with granting/denial pulses, interactive floor map quick widget with door remote trigger, and mini camera matrix.

key_features_to_build.name: Interactive Building Floor Map
key_features_to_build.description: Stylized interactive vector blueprint layout of Floor 4 (Lobby, Server Room, Exec Suite, Parking Gate, Emergency Exit). Interactive door nodes pinned on layout showing real-time state (Locked - Cyan glow, Unlocked - Emerald, Alarm - Red flash, Remote Open - Pulsing). Click any door to trigger remote unlock with countdown, override controls, and view assigned NVR camera stream.

key_features_to_build.name: NVR Real-Time Video Grid
key_features_to_build.description: 4 to 8 channel camera feed grid with dark surveillance aesthetic, live timestamp overlay, camera names (CAM-01 LOBBY MAIN, CAM-02 SERVER ROOM, CAM-03 PARKING B1, CAM-04 EXEC CORRIDOR), recording state dot (REC red pulse), full screen zoom modal, motion detection indicators, and PTZ control overlay.

key_features_to_build.name: Employee Enrollment & Biometrics Sync
key_features_to_build.description: Manage personnel access list with high-res headshot avatars, card RFID numbers (e.g., RFID-994021), facial recognition embedding vector status ('FACE SYNCED - 99.8% match'), access level badges, and modal to enroll new employee (upload photo, simulate facial scan capture with grid overlay, assign card reader access, sync with physical gateways).

key_features_to_build.name: Access Devices & Gateway Manager
key_features_to_build.description: Hardware matrix showing connected Gateways, NVR units, Facial Scanners, and RFID Card Readers. Details include IP address, firmware version, online/offline status badge, signal strength, and sync trigger button.

key_features_to_build.name: Real-time Access Events Log
key_features_to_build.description: Searchable and filterable audit log of every entry attempt. Filter by Door, Access Granted/Denied, Biometric vs Card, Time range. Live stream switch to toggle incoming fake events dynamically.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all interactive components (buttons, tabs, inputs, door nodes, action triggers) contain 'data-testid' attributes (e.g., data-testid='door-unlock-btn-01', data-testid='employee-enroll-modal-submit').
Use dark background (#050811) with deep blue gradients and electric blue (#06b6d4) glows across all cards and map nodes.
Implement Lucide React icons for tactical security representation (Shield, Lock, Unlock, Camera, Cpu, Wifi, Radio, UserCheck, AlertTriangle, Key, Layers).
Ensure non-transparent backgrounds on all drop downs, modals, popovers, and overlays (use bg-[#0f172a] or bg-[#0b1220] with backdrop-blur).
Add interactive micro-feedback: Sonner toasts when remote opening doors, triggering biometrics sync, or adding new employees.
Keep code pure JavaScript / JSX, avoiding TypeScript definitions since target files are .js/.jsx.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur)
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
